notes.title: Newsletter launched!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that I've made a mailing list!
If you subscribe, you'll get access to cool behind the scenes stuff, early playtesting, and polls/voting!

There are big things to announce soon, and I'll be doing more extensive write-ups on the mailing list.
If you don't want to subscribe, you can join my [url=https://discord.gg/Yj3qVt8DDg]discord[/url], where I'll be posting stuff as well.

After you subscribe, the welcome email has a special challenge, which I'm not sure anyone will solve :P

[url=https://evilcorpgames.beehiiv.com/]SIGN UP[/url]

+ Various bug-fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: 1.2 UPDATE RELEASED!
notes.content:
Version 1.2.2
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added 5 "Master Ducks" which provide permanent bonuses, found by moving with the arrows on screen. These can be bought with the new currency of destroyed ducks.
[*] Added 10 new ducks!
[*] Added timed events. A question mark might pop out of a destroyed duck and will provide temporary bonuses.
[*] Ducks are now sold instead of being trashed. You will gain the reward of the duck being sold. When your slots are full, the captured duck gets automatically sold.
[*] Added an option to reset your entire game in the settings.
[*] Small tweaks and bug-fixes.
[*] QUACK.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Update releases in the coming weeks!
notes.content: Following the release & positive and constructive feedback, I've started working on an update for the game. I won't announce any coming features yet, but it will be a sizeable update, which will introduce new mechanics!
